LBR.note: No link between civil register and the NIR stated.
The paper names nationwide NIR coverage as a challenge but gives no enrolment count.
No operation or maintenance arrangement stated.

facts.fact: The paper's findings state the NEC and NIR databases operate as two separate databases, so the voter register is not drawn from the NIR.

The National Identification Registry, established in 2011 after the rollout of national biometric ID cards, registers citizens and non-citizens with a unique identification number, fingerprint data and photo.
